Class StationRepository

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.Mdisc.repo.StationRepository
public class StationRepository extends Object
Repository for loading Station instances from a CSV file.

Expects a single line of input where each token is formatted as: 

   TYPE_name
(e.g., "S_Dingwall;D_Helmsdale;T_Inverness"). Tokens are separated by semicolons. The repository parses each token, creates a Station, and returns a sorted list by type then name.

  • Method Details

    • loadAll

      public List<Station> loadAll() throws FileNotFoundException
      Loads and returns all Station instances from the configured file.

      Parsing logic:

      1. Read the first line of the file (if any).
      2. Split line at semicolons into tokens.
      3. For each token, split at the first underscore into type code and name.
      4. Create a StationType from the code and a new Station.
      5. Ignore malformed tokens.
      6. Sort the resulting list by station type (ordinal) then name.
      Returns:
      sorted List of Station instances, empty if file is empty
      Throws:
      FileNotFoundException - if the stations file cannot be opened
